values.note: Barron County's own reservation site; walk-in bookings are taken at the campground office May 1-September 30, primitive sites are first-come only, and a reserved site still empty at 3 pm the day after check-in is opened to drive-ins. The 14-night limit does not apply to monthly rentals (sites 1-14). One person may reserve at most 2 sites at a time. No refunds; changes allowed more than 14 days out.

note: Barron County park on the east side of Ten Mile Lake, south of Chetek: wooded gravel-and-grass sites under tall pines, set back from the shore, with the tent sites (28-30) nearest the lake. Sites 1-14 may also be rented by the month. Boat landing with docks. ATVs and UTVs may use the park roads. --Claude
summary: County reservation site and rules read: $30 electric/$20 tent, $5 reservation fee, 30 sites (26 electric with water, 50 A at seven), 12-month window, 14-night max, May 1-Sep 30, coin showers, pit toilets, dump. 2027 calendars are mostly open and only sites 6E/7E show month-long blocks: a nightly park. Lakeview -> not waterfront lead; pin ~250 m off; phone changed.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD: stored lakeview -> not waterfront. The electric RV sites are not on the shore: the county map puts the tent sites 28-30 (and 26E, a tent site with electric) between the lake and the RV loops. On zoom-18 Esri imagery the nearest RV sites (22E-25E, around 45.2993,-91.6178) are ~40-60 m from the water under continuous pine canopy, and sites 1E-14E sit at the far (east/northeast) side ~100 m+ away. The county's own photos of sites 18E, 22E, 23E, 24E and 25E show pine woods and the restroom buildings, no water. No official photo shows a lake view from an RV site, so the view is not earned.

NIGHTLY SHARE: not seasonal. All 26 RV sites sell by the day; sites 1-14 may also be rented by the month ($600/30 days; 14E 'RESERVATIONS RESTRICTED TO 30 DAY MINIMUM'). The 2027 availability calendars (read 2026-11-16) show most sites with 0-12 booked nights a month; only 6E and 7E are blocked for June-July, 15E, 24E and 27E most of June. Google 4.4 from 41 reviews ('Perfect quiet little campground', 'Not crowded like some campgrounds are').

PIN: stored 45.3013,-91.6142 sits east of 26 1/2-27th Street in woods, ~250 m from the campground. The restroom/shower loop is at ~45.2995,-91.6168 on imagery; suggest 45.2999,-91.6167 (between the restroom loop and the sites 1E-14E rows). Google's pin (45.29854,-91.61673) is a private lot south of the park.

PHONE: stored 715-537-6295 appears on no county page. The park page gives '(715) 418-1812 (Mobile)' May 1-September 30 and '(715) 537-6132' October 1-April 30; the department letterhead gives 715-537-6365. Suggest 715-537-6295 -> 715-418-1812 (campground, in season), or 715-537-6132 year-round.

FIT: three sites are posted '20-25 FT' (1E, 10E, B-E); 23 of the 26 electric sites are posted 30 ft to 40+ ft. One older review: 'Interior roads are narrow, winding and tree lined!' (a 36-ft motorhome).
ATV/UTV: 'New for 2025: ATV/UTVs now permitted at county parks' (on designated travel ways only, not in quiet hours). A general campground with ATV access, not an OHV camp.
NAME: the county calls it 'Southworth Memorial Park' (entry: 'Southworth County Park').
